title: Evaluating and Simplifying Rational Compositions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Given f(x) = x - 1 and g(x) = 1 / (x + 1), find the following: (a) f(g(1/2)), (b) g(f(1/2)), (c) f(g(x)), (d) g(f(x)), (e) f(f(2)), (f) g(g(2)), (g) f(f(x)), and (h) g(g(x)).

steps.title: Evaluate Numerical Compositions in Parts (a), (b), (e), and (f)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(a) } f(g(1/2)) &= f\left(\frac{1}{1/2 + 1}\right) = f\left(\frac{2}{3}\right) = \frac{2}{3} - 1 = -\frac{1}{3} \\ \text{(b) } g(f(1/2)) &= g\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{-1/2 + 1} = 2 \\ \text{(e) } f(f(2)) &= f(2 - 1) = f(1) = 1 - 1 = 0 \\ \text{(f) } g(g(2)) &= g\left(\frac{1}{3}\right) = \frac{1}{1/3 + 1} = \frac{3}{4} \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: Evaluate the inner function at the specified numerical input first, then feed that output into the outer function.
steps.why: Nested function evaluations proceed from the innermost parentheses outward.

steps.title: Compute Symbolic Cross-Compositions in Parts (c) and (d)
steps.explanation: Substitute g(x) into f(x) and combine over the common denominator x + 1 for part (c). Substitute f(x) = x - 1 into g(x) and simplify the denominator for part (d).
steps.why: Rational expressions are simplified by combining terms over a common denominator.

steps.title: Compute Symbolic Self-Compositions in Parts (g) and (h)
steps.explanation: For part (g), subtracting 1 twice gives x - 2. For part (h), multiply numerator and denominator of the complex fraction by x + 1 to obtain (x + 1)/(x + 2).
steps.why: Multiplying numerator and denominator by the inner denominator clears the complex fraction.
